study: Momentum Persistence / Reversal Regime Audit v1
purpose: Test the narrow ex-ante hypothesis that five already-frozen momentum portfolios have stronger SPY-relative daily returns during persistent market trends than during pullback/rebound transition states.

strategySources.configuration: 63-session lookback, top 5, daily rebalance, frozen 26-symbol universe
strategySources.execution: Use the frozen execution overlay in research/dm_regime_dependence_v1_preregistration.json.

strategySources.configuration: 189-session lookback, top 5, monthly rebalance, point-in-time Dow membership
126-session market-residual momentum, skip 5, top 5, monthly rebalance, point-in-time Dow membership

strategySources.source: Derived only from runs 26 and 24 using the frozen fixed 50/50 monthly reset rule
Derived only from runs 26 and 24 using the frozen 60-session inverse-volatility monthly reset rule

stateInformationTiming: Every state for strategy return session T uses only SPY closes available through T-1.

stateInputs.longTermTrend: SPY close T-1 strictly above its 200-session simple moving average computed through T-1
stateInputs.shortTermDirection: SPY total return from close T-22 through close T-1 strictly above zero

states.definition: long-term trend true and short-term direction positive
long-term trend true and short-term direction non-positive
long-term trend false and short-term direction non-positive
long-term trend false and short-term direction positive

outcomes.primary: Daily active return: strategy close-to-close return T minus SPY close-to-close return T

primaryHypothesis.estimand: Mean active return on persistence sessions (bullish_persistence plus bearish_persistence) minus mean active return on transition sessions (pullback plus rebound)
primaryHypothesis.family: Five tests, one per frozen strategy; Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all five

classification.stableCandidate: All stability gates pass; still requires independent prospective validation before any trading use.
classification.unsupportedOrUnstable: At least one stability gate fails.
classification.exploratoryHistorical: Applied to Optimized DM and both derived overlays regardless of statistics because their selection/design used the analyzed history.

interpretationGuards: State tables are attribution diagnostics, not a backtest of switching a strategy on and off.
No best-state label may be interpreted as predictive when the five-test primary family fails.
Secondary contrasts and absolute-return summaries cannot rescue a failed primary active-return test.
No additional state, threshold, lookback, outcome, or interaction may be added after results are observed.
No condition may suppress, resize, create, modify, or cancel a live or paper order.
Optimized DM and both portfolio overlays remain exploratory historical evidence regardless of p-values.
